analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/build.md. It bumps the last-updated date (line 3) and rewrites the description of the darkbloom-watchdog workflow (lines ~437-449). The copied watchdog pin moves from 31236c54 to d6d257c2. The new text describes broader rescue conditions: stranded time is counted from job creation, and a run is rescued when only some jobs are stranded. It also warns that jobs waiting on payer concurrency limits can look stranded, and advises setting DARKBLOOM_WATCHDOG_MINUTES above such waits. The watchdog token stays limited to actions:write and checks:write on this repository. The doc says release and signing runs are never touched because only CI and other routed workflows carry Darkbloom labels, so the doc claim leaves the release/signing trust path unchanged. Rescue is limited to once per run; a second stranding only cancels it. No source, workflow YAML, provider code or threat-model-relevant control is changed in this diff. I checked the change against the retained threat definitions (T-041 and the TB-002/003/007/009/011 families) and found no interaction. The documented watchdog behavior concerns CI availability only and does not touch provider custody, attestation, App Attest authorization, coordinator wire handling or the prefix cache. Remaining unverified point: the actual watchdog workflow file (d6d257c2) is not in the supplied evidence, so I cannot confirm it matches the documented behavior, including the claim that release runs are excluded. The threat model does not cover CI infrastructure, so that doesn't invalidate any provider assumption.
